purpose: Assess every module, application, applet, service, function, protocol, procedure, framework and governance lane for shippable maturity, corrective workflows, pending workloads and executable deployment actions without treating target-host or provider gates as global failure.

issue_taxonomy.MISSING_K_APP_PACKAGE: Component has no local K-APP package or manifest readback yet.
issue_taxonomy.TARGET_HOST_GATE_PENDING: M3/launchd/iostat/browser readback proof is required before native-host promotion.
issue_taxonomy.PROVIDER_GATE_PENDING: External provider, remote attestation, Drive/SIMB/Gemini/OpenAI, DNS/TLS or peer envelope proof is required.
issue_taxonomy.REVIEW_SURFACE_TOO_LARGE: Current PR surface should be split after executable receipts are captured to reduce review and release risk.
issue_taxonomy.TEST_RECEIPT_REQUIRED: Tests must execute and emit a receipt; existing test files alone do not count.
issue_taxonomy.INTEGRITY_READBACK_REQUIRED: Manifest integrity must be read back before node-side execution.
issue_taxonomy.DEPENDENCY_ISOLATION_REQUIRED: Blocked dependency must create continuation work and not poison unrelated runtime domains.

corrective_workflows.target_host: register self-hosted M3 runner, run v98-host-acceptance, capture launchd/iostat/browser receipts
corrective_workflows.provider_gate: capture signed peer/provider receipt, keep local outbox until provider returns
corrective_workflows.split_release: split PR into application shipping, resilience, K-Cloud, governance, and target-host follow-up lanes after local receipt pack is stable

governance.review_boundary: large PR allowed only as integration workbench; release should be split once evidence exists
